gloss: male friend; friend who is a man

definitions.explanation: A friend who is a man or boy. Usually said to make clear that the friendship is not romantic, especially by a woman talking about a man she is friends with.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{男友達|おとこともだち}です。
⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男友達|おとこともだち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: At the weekend I went to see a film with a male friend.

examples.japanese: {男友達|おとこともだち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}っている→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{誤解|ごかい}される→誤解する：19638_gokaisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When I go out alone with a male friend, people sometimes assume we're dating.

notes:
⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧ (man) + ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧ (friend). The counterpart is {女友達|おんなともだち} (female friend).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{男友達|おとこともだち}: just a (male) friend
- {男友達|おとこともだち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have many male friends
- ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{男友達|おとこともだち}: a close male friend

WATCH OUT:
English "boyfriend" is ⟦{彼氏|かれし}→彼氏：06456_kareshi⟧ or ⟦ボーイフレンド→ボーイフレンド：27291_booifurendo⟧, not {男友達|おとこともだち}. ⟦ボーイフレンド→ボーイフレンド：27291_booifurendo⟧ can still mean just a male friend in older usage, but today it nearly always means a partner, so {男友達|おとこともだち} is the safe way to say there is no romance.
